This is child's play.
Puhuhuhu...

<CLT=cltMIND>Students must live at the Ultimate Academy for
the remainder of their foreseeable future.

<CLT=cltMIND>Once a murder takes place, all surviving
students must participate in a class trial.

<CLT=cltMIND>If the blackened is exposed during the class
trial, they alone will be executed.

<CLT=cltMIND>If the blackened is not exposed, all remaining
students will be executed.

<CLT=cltMIND>If the blackened survives the class trial, they
will graduate and re-enter the outside world.

<CLT=cltMIND>The killing game and class trials will continue
until only two surviving students remain.

<CLT=cltMIND>"Nighttime" is from 10 p.m. to 8 a.m. The dining
hall and gymnasium are off-limits at night.

<CLT=cltMIND>Monokuma will never directly commit
a murder.

<CLT=cltMIND>Your Monopads are very important items.
Please do not damage them.

<CLT=cltMIND>The Body Discovery Announcement will play
when three or more students discover a body.

<CLT=cltMIND>With minimal restrictions, you are free to
explore the campus at your discretion.

<CLT=cltMIND>Students who violate these rules will be
immediately exterminated by the Exisals.

<CLT=cltMIND>Is this real...?
Are we really in a killing game?

Stop messing around with us... I will...
never...ever participate in a killing game—

[Tentative] Title Ch. 1 "My Class Trial,
Our Class Trial" (Non) Daily Life

The Ultimate Academy for Gifted 
Juveniles School Regulations...

Who would force us to play a game like this?
And why, for that matter...?
Who cares? It seems totally unboring.

Wh-What about this could you like!?
This is the worst!
Kehehe... Don't raise your voice so.

Hey, hey! What does this sixth regulation
mean?

The killing game and class trials will continue 
until only two surviving students remain.

Only <CLT=cltSTRONG>two surviving students<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
What would be the reason for that?

Perhaps it's because you couldn't
do a trial with just two people...?

Ohhh, I see.
You're so smart, Shuichi.
Killing game... School Regulations...

Quit screwing around! Who'd go along 
with something like that!?

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito raised the Monopad as if to smash the
device onto the ground.
Whoa, hey now, don't do that.
School rules say you can't break it.

If you violate the rules,
then the Exisals will punish you...

Shut up! I don't care! No way I'm gonna 
go along with this messed up game!

This isn't about "going along" with him.
It's too dangerous to disobey him now.

Forget about him! Just means one less
dumbass for the world to deal with!
Hey! Who you callin' a dumbass!?
<CLT=cltMIND>I inhaled, and then shouted with all my might.
Geez! We don't have time to fight!
Whoa! Wh-What the!?

We shouldn't be fighting among friends!
At times like these, we need to cooperate!

Honestly... Rather than giving a speech,
it would be way faster if I played a song.

Chopin's "Military Polonaise" would definitely
help solidify our bond!

Yeah, bolognese is pretty good.
Even though I'm not fond of meat or tomatoes.

I also agree with Kaede!
We can't fight among friends!

Master told me we must aim our strength
at the right direction!

A-Anyway...you're all panicking too much...
Just...stay calm...like me...
Wow! You're shaking so much!

Even I can't handle these intense vibrations!
And trust me—I've got loads of experience!
...Wh-What does that mean?

Anyway...let's work together and look for
the exit again.

But...we looked all over that wall 
and there wasn't a single hole.

Hm? Now wait just a second.
If there's no opening in the wall...

Then...how did we get inside these
walls in the first place?
Huh...? Oh, that's right, isn't it?

Then that means...there has to be a hole
somewhere! We just need to look for it!

Whoever trapped us in here wants us to
fight each other, but...
That won't happen! We'll show you!

We won't fight each other!
Instead, we'll work together!
<CLT=cltMIND>...

Why are you quiet...?
Did I say something wrong?
No, that is not it.

You have stated everything in a straight-forward
manner, so there is nothing else to say.

You're exactly right!
We can't give up so easily!
Yeah, that's right!
We should split up and try to find the exit!
...Oh, um, can Gonta say something?

Why? We were just getting 
ready to go.
Ummm... Is probably nothing, but...

Gonta...found manhole in grass.
Behind school building.
A manhole?

Yeah. Looked like underground passage.
Gonta thought it might be exit...
...No. Is probably not so simple.

Gyaaaaaa! You gotta mention that kind of
important stuff faster!

Yeah. Lookedlikeundergroundpassage.
Gontathoughtitmightbeexit...
Wait, not like that! You're talking too fast!

Anyway, let us go and confirm it. It is behind
the school, correct? Please guide us, Gonta.
O-Okay! Follow Gonta!

<CLT=cltMIND>With Gonta at the lead, everyone scurried
out of the gym.
<CLT=cltMIND>Just when I was about to follow after them...
...Kaede, that was pretty cool back there.
Huh? About what?

The way you changed the mood back there.
Looks like everyone's looking up to you.

L-Looking up to me... You're exaggerating.
I just said what was on my mind...

So it just comes naturally to you, then.
That's even more cool.
You have what it takes to win...
What...?

I was just thinking, what you said back there
would have pissed off whoever's running this.

They definitely don't want us
holding hands, workin' together...

...They're going to come for you, Kaede.
With everything they've got.

I'm a little worried about you.
You're just so...straightforward.

And there he goes...
I wish he wasn't so cryptic...

Ah, perhaps it's a warning?
That's what I think, anyway...

Being strong willed could get you
into a lot of trouble around here...

Ah, s-sorry... I didn't mean to sound
so negative at a time like this.

No, don't worry.
You only told me because you're worried, right?

Yeah... Rantaro is a mystery.
He forgot his Ultimate talent as well...

Is that something you
can really...forget?

Well, there's no point thinking about it.
Anyway, we should head to where the manhole is.
Ah, you're right...
